chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar al-Yamani, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays; and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah; and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays, who said:
I heard Abdullah ibn Ja‘far al-Tayyar saying: We were with Mu‘awiyah—I, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Umm Salamah, and Usamah ibn Zayd—and words passed between me and Mu‘awiyah.

So I said to Mu‘awiyah: I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say: I have greater authority over the believers than their own selves; then my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves. Then when Ali عليه السلام is martyred, al-Hasan ibn Ali عليهما السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves. Then after him, my son al-Husayn عليه السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves. Then when he is martyred, his son Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves, and you will meet him, O Ali. Then his son Muhammad ibn Ali عليهما السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves, and you will meet him, O Husayn. Then it is completed as twelve Imams, nine from the descendants of al-Husayn عليه السلام.

Abdullah ibn Ja‘far said: And I called al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Umm Salamah, and Usamah ibn Zayd as witnesses, and they testified for me before Mu‘awiyah. Sulaym said: I had also heard that from Salman, Abu Dharr, and al-Miqdad, and they mentioned that they had heard it from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.أَوْلَى: having greater authority and closer right over the believers
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers, the community of faith

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the twelve Imams and the succession of authority after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a declaration attributed to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله establishing his prior authority over the believers and then the successive authority of Imam Ali عليه السلام, Imam al-Hasan عليه السلام, Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, and the continuation of the line until the twelve Imams. It presents this as a witnessed report in the presence of Mu‘awiyah and reinforces it through multiple named companions.
